protocol.filterTrainingObjective: equal-day mean of (UW-volume-weighted BA error + 0.25 * bucket-equal P95 + 0.10 * fraction above 10pp)
protocol.constraints: In each training day retain at least target fraction of BOTH buckets and IB volume. No missing BA, at least 10 buckets. Config selection additionally requires >=70% directional volume coverage.
protocol.validation: Leave one entire trading day out. No row-wise random split. Feature and threshold selection never use held-out UW labels. This is exploratory internal validation on already observed dates, NOT a prospective accuracy test. The method-only family was examined after all-family validation and is post-hoc; chronological replay cannot undo this selection.
protocol.scope: 9/28 excludes 15:55–16:00. All dates exclude final UW bucket and unreconstructed data. UW is a reference, not ground truth.
